messages:
Maya: Morning triage — quick snapshot:
- queue size: 74 (up ~12 since midnight)
- P1s: 3 (two look like same-customer rate anomaly)
- P2s: 12
Known issue: embeddings requests timing out in us-west (~10% failure rate). Started ~2026-03-17T05:10 UTC and still trickling.
Macros: switched to /macro/embed-retry-v2 (adds 3x backoff + logging). Use for affected tickets.
Action items: assigning P1s to @Sam and @Rahul. I'll patch macros and drop runbook excerpt below.

Sam: Got it. Can you paste the error snippet so I can repro locally?

Maya: Sure — log excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T05:12:03Z ERROR embedding/pool.go: timeout after 12s: retried 2
request_id: abc123
model: text-embed-ada-002-quant
region: us-west-2
```

Rahul: Thanks — looks like a kernel-side socket timeout regression after last night's infra deploy. I opened a draft PR to bump socket timeout + add jitter: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/842. Tagging @Jess for planned rollout.

Jess: I can do the rollout after 06:30 UTC. Recommend canary 5% for 15m, then 25% for 10m if green. Rollback flag: ENABLE_EMBED_FIX=false. I'll update the runbook with rollback steps.

ops-bot: alert: embeddings-timeout-high | us-west | rate=0.11 | window=15m | started=2026-03-17T05:10:00Z

Leo: FYI — customer ACME reported degraded embeddings in eu-central too. Are we seeing cross-region effects or just retries causing downstream queuing?

Maya: ACME ticket #3821 shows eu timeouts but lower rate (3%). Could be transit grpc flakiness + load amplification from retries. I added a new macro: /macro/embeds-investigation which includes: checks to run, logs to gather, and quick remediation (restart affected pods, enable fallback model).

Sam: Ping @Rahul — can you add a small load test that simulates slow kernel responses so we don't regress again? Also needs code review on PR #842.

Rahul: On it. I'll add a unit + integration test that simulates kernel stall and tag you in review. ETA ~2h.

Jess: Shift handoff note — if issues persist at 08:00 UTC escalate to eng-sre and trigger full rollback plan.

Maya: I'll update all open tickets with the /macro/embed-retry-v2 text and DM affected customers. Small ask: react with :eyes: if you're actively tracking so I can coordinate handoffs.

Sam: :eyes:

Rahul: :thumbsup:

Leo: :eyes:
